notes: The river jungle sits between the beach and the elven precinct on the escalation schedule: its drowned bearer walks the nights from day 8 and its tomb wight the daylight from day 11.

intent_suite is what this habitat advertises its holder will open with, not its holder's skill list -- the tideline advertises one skill while enemy.raptor.razorbeak declares two -- which is why content/enemies/boar.thunderback.json leaves skillIds open rather than reading them off this line.
Field names and value spellings are HabitatRecord's in godot-rust/src/habitat.rs verbatim, because habitat::tests::fixture_matches_the_authored_habitats holds the two equal field for field.
